description: Tests whether a user or role has specific access rights to a Sitecore item.

database.description: Database to resolve an id against (default master).

id.description: The ID of the item to test access rights on. Supply this or path.

identity.description: The identity of the user or role to test (e.g. 'sitecore\admin')

path.description: The path of the item to test access rights on (e.g. /sitecore/content/Home). Supply this or id.

propType.description: The propagation type for the access right

name: security-test-item-acl
